harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created opsbot on both nodes, generated its ED25519 key on node1, authorized it on both systems, and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication. Verified node1 can execute commands as opsbot on node2. Both nodes retained configuration and functionality through sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Created opsbot accounts and secured SSH directories.
Generated the client key on node1 and installed its public key on both nodes.
Configured SSH to require public-key authentication for opsbot, disabling password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Verified successful key login and rejection when no key is offered on both nodes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: opsbot accounts and matching key authorization
evidence.summary: Accounts exist and the ED25519 key fingerprint SHA256:3lTwiM+Xfm+VdS2ge84Zr032zD77pqVxpkA+3bYPzQY is installed with secure ownership and permissions.

evidence.requirement: node1 can run commands as opsbot on node2
evidence.summary: Key-authenticated sessions from node1 reached node2 as opsbot before and after restarts, including successful command and persisted-data checks.

evidence.requirement: Key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems
evidence.summary: Effective policy on both nodes is AuthenticationMethods=publickey with password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled; no-key attempts were rejected.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f, acknowledged reboot, changed ID 71c5c8b3-13f6-435d-bfa7-06abfccff052, and recovered account, keys, listener, policy, local/remote login, and no-key rejection.

Healthy baseline boot ID 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb, acknowledged reboot, changed ID 56a58abe-8b5b-476b-bcb0-320ce3e916b0, and recovered SSH service, account, authorized key, persisted data, key-only policy, and cross-node login.
